name: Menu button
purpose: Offers a few more things the user can do with something on a card, such as a vehicle or a driving licence, without crowding the card: a round “…” button that opens a menu of them.

origin.notes: The app's menuView on a vehicle's card (VehicleSummaryView) and on a driving licence (DrivingLicenceSummaryView): SF's ellipsis.circle.fill in Title 1 Bold, in text.link, in a 36pt box, which opens a SwiftUI Menu of links. The menu's look is iOS's, approximated.

label.description: The button's name for screen readers, as the app's moreOptionsButtonAccessibilityLabel.

name.description: The button's name, to tell it apart when it's pressed.

inputs.content: Its menu's items, <govuk-app-menu-button-item> elements, top to bottom. Each is a link, with an href, or a button, with a name and value. Its label is what's written between its tags.

events.name: click
events.description: From the button, which opens the menu, and from an item's link or button, when it's chosen; choosing one closes the menu.

rules: Use it for a few things the user can do with what's on its card, that don't need to be on show. Anything they'll want often belongs on the card itself.
Put it at the top right of its card, as the app does.
Keep its menu short, a handful of items at most, each saying what it does, such as Change address.
Label it for screen readers if More options doesn't say enough.

other.title: Apple Human Interface Guidelines: Pull-down buttons

references.description: On a vehicle's card, beside its number plate, in light mode

examples.name: A vehicle's menu
examples.html:
<govuk-app-menu-button name="vehicle-menu">
  <govuk-app-menu-button-item href="https://www.gov.uk/vehicle-tax">Tax this vehicle</govuk-app-menu-button-item>
  <govuk-app-menu-button-item href="https://www.gov.uk/getting-an-mot">Book an MOT</govuk-app-menu-button-item>
  <govuk-app-menu-button-item name="remove-vehicle">Remove vehicle</govuk-app-menu-button-item>
</govuk-app-menu-button>
